title: Equal1, NVIDIA, and Dell Technologies Demonstrate Real-Time Hybrid Quantum-Classical Rack Integration at SC26 - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Silicon spin-qubit developer Equal1 has collaborated with NVIDIA and Dell Technologies to demonstrate an integrated hybrid quantum-classical computing architecture at the SC26 supercomputing conference in Chicago. Hosted at the Dell Technologies booth, the demonstration paired Equal1’s 1.6 kW rack-mounted RacQ silicon quantum computer with Dell data center servers inside a standard rack footprint.

The joint software and interconnect stack combines NVIDIA Ising Calibration open models for automated gate tuning—including real-time controlled-Z (CZ) gate calibration, with NVIDIA NVQLink to provide ultra-low-latency round-trip communication between quantum processors and GPUs. Hybrid execution across the classical and quantum hardware is coordinated by the Dell Quantum Intelligent Orchestrator (QIO) software prototype.

Read Equal1’s technical announcement here and CEO Jason Lynch’s blog post on quantum-AI power economics here, and view Equal1’s SC26 showcase post on LinkedIn here.
